search_scope.eligibility_rule: A reusable physical experiment or in-use fill must expose station/controller and dispenser/nozzle plus vehicle/receptacle channels on a common time base, with initial conditions, units, tank capacity and protocol metadata.

candidates.name: NREL H2FillS
candidates.reason: The time-series fields are simulator outputs; the page does not provide independent measured station-to-vehicle logger traces.

candidates.name: NREL Next Generation Hydrogen Station Composite Data Products: Retail Stations
candidates.observed_role: aggregate station performance, reliability and safety statistics
candidates.reason: The published products are aggregate charts and summaries, not synchronized station/dispenser/vehicle raw time series.

candidates.name: MetHyTrucks Group B -- HySam system measurement data
candidates.reason: The workbooks contain sampling-system pressure/temperature/flow-like channels but no vehicle/receptacle tank channels, station controller state or full station-to-vehicle common-clock context. This source is already consumed under the frozen component diagnostic boundary.

primary_goal_decision.paper_limitation: No openly reusable synchronized station-to-vehicle raw trace was identified in the recheck. The study therefore does not claim independent station-to-vehicle full-loop accuracy, vehicle-controller validation or field-safety validation.
primary_goal_decision.reentry_condition: A custodian must provide at least three rights-cleared, independently documented events with station/controller, dispenser/nozzle and vehicle/receptacle channels on a common time base, including units, initial conditions, tank capacity and protocol metadata; the analysis protocol must be frozen before outcome access.
